summary: Keep help and no-version-sync delivery coherent

delivery.outcome: Goal help is read-only and explicit commit-only delivery cannot enter contradictory release version validation
nonGoals: No release carrier, package publication, Git tag or GitHub Release change
No weakening of normal committed-unreleased package source detection
No new CLI flag, command or runtime dependency

architecture.decision: Reuse the existing read-only context path for help and derive one explicit commit-only predicate before committed-unreleased release resolution
architecture.rollback: Restore mutable help initialization and allow explicit commit-only flags to re-enter release resolution

validation.evidence: subcommand help does not create or rewrite goal.yaml
committed source plus explicit commit-only flags stays on the released version and performs no release side effect
ordinary committed-unreleased source still enters release resolution

commands: ruff check goal/cli/__init__.py goal/push/core.py tests/test_delivery_integrity.py tests/test_push_e2e.py
validation.evidence: focused/full tests, lint, governance and package/container builds pass
